name: AMRAP 10
instructions_short: Complete as many quality rounds as possible in 10 minutes.
instructions_long: Cycle through all cards for 10 minutes at a sustainable pace. Record rounds and reps for repeatability.
science_rationale: Density-style work supports conditioning and local muscular endurance.
safety_notes: Avoid racing early; leave one or two reps in reserve.

name: AMRAP 15
instructions_short: Complete as many quality rounds as possible in 15 minutes.
instructions_long: Move steadily through five cards for the full time. Rest briefly before form degrades.
science_rationale: Longer density blocks favor aerobic support and pacing practice.
safety_notes: Scale high-skill movements before fatigue accumulates.

name: AMRAP 5
instructions_short: Complete as many quality rounds as possible in 5 minutes.
instructions_long: Cycle through the drawn cards for 5 minutes. Keep reps smooth and record rounds plus extra reps.
science_rationale: Short repeated circuits can build density and conditioning when effort is controlled.
safety_notes: Prioritize technique over speed and stop for pain.

name: Build the Stack 10
work_structure: Add one new card each round
instructions_short: Add the next card each round until the stack is complete.
instructions_long: Round one uses card one. Round two uses cards one and two. Continue building and repeat as time allows.
science_rationale: Stacking creates repeated practice of early movements with rising complexity.
safety_notes: Place technical cards later only if fatigue risk is low.

name: Build the Stack 15
work_structure: Add one new card each round
instructions_short: Build a five-card stack over 15 minutes.
instructions_long: Add one card per round until all five are included; then continue full-stack rounds as time allows.
science_rationale: Stack formats accumulate volume in a predictable way.
safety_notes: Watch fatigue on repeated early cards.

name: Cardio Sandwich 10
instructions_short: Bracket strength work with conditioning cards.
instructions_long: Alternate conditioning and strength emphasis for 10 minutes. Keep the conditioning card repeatable.
science_rationale: Mixed emphasis supports variety and conditioning without complex planning.
safety_notes: Avoid high impact if joints are irritated.

name: Cardio Sandwich 5
work_structure: Cardio card before and after strength card
instructions_short: Place a conditioning card before and after a strength card.
instructions_long: Use card one; then card two; then card one again. Repeat for 5 minutes with controlled effort.
science_rationale: Alternating conditioning and strength can raise heart rate while preserving simple structure.
safety_notes: Use low-impact cardio choices for beginners.

name: Chaser 10
work_structure: Main cards followed by a short finisher
instructions_short: Finish each round with a short conditioning chaser.
instructions_long: Complete the strength or skill cards; then perform the chaser card for a short timed burst. Repeat for 10 minutes.
science_rationale: Finishers add conditioning while keeping most work controlled.
safety_notes: The chaser should be simple and scalable.

name: Chipper 10
instructions_short: Complete the card list once in order.
instructions_long: Work through all cards once using the prescribed reps or time. If time expires; record where you finished.
science_rationale: Chippers emphasize task completion and pacing across varied movements.
safety_notes: Do not sprint the first card; keep transitions safe.

name: Chipper 15
instructions_short: Complete the longer card list once in order.
instructions_long: Move through six cards one time. Record finish time or final completed card at 15 minutes.
science_rationale: Task-priority formats support varied conditioning and simple scoring.
safety_notes: Scale volume for loaded or technical cards.

name: Density Block 10
instructions_short: Repeat fixed reps and aim for quality density.
instructions_long: Choose manageable reps for each card and repeat the circuit for 10 minutes. Record total quality rounds.
science_rationale: Density blocks make progress measurable without maximal loading.
safety_notes: Keep reps submaximal and breathe between sets.

name: Density Block 15
instructions_short: Repeat fixed reps for a longer quality block.
instructions_long: Use five cards and a sustainable pace. Record rounds completed with good technique.
science_rationale: Longer density sessions build work capacity and pacing skill.
safety_notes: Reduce reps if quality drops after the midpoint.

name: EMOM 10
work_structure: One card at the top of each minute
instructions_short: Start a card each minute for 10 minutes.
instructions_long: Rotate through the drawn cards until 10 minutes are complete. Keep each minute repeatable.
science_rationale: Fixed intervals support quality practice under mild fatigue.
safety_notes: Keep loads conservative for repeated starts.

name: EMOM 15
work_structure: One card at the top of each minute
instructions_short: Start a card each minute for 15 minutes.
instructions_long: Use a sustainable rep target and rotate through five cards. Rest during the remainder of each minute.
science_rationale: Longer interval practice supports consistency and pacing.
safety_notes: Do not chase failure; scale reps early.

name: EMOM 5
work_structure: One card at the top of each minute
instructions_short: Start a card each minute and rest with remaining time.
instructions_long: Rotate through cards at the top of each minute for 5 minutes. Choose reps that leave rest before the next minute.
science_rationale: Intervals create predictable work-rest exposure and pacing feedback.
safety_notes: Reduce reps if you cannot finish with safe form.

name: Ladder 10
instructions_short: Add reps each round for 10 minutes.
instructions_long: Move through four cards and increase the rep target each completed round.
science_rationale: Gradual increases encourage pacing and repeatability.
safety_notes: Cap reps before technique fails.

name: Ladder 15
instructions_short: Add reps each round for 15 minutes.
instructions_long: Use five cards and climb carefully. Keep the ladder submaximal until the final minutes.
science_rationale: Ladders provide progressive density over a defined time.
safety_notes: Use regressions once fatigue affects control.

name: Ladder 5
instructions_short: Add reps each round for 5 minutes.
instructions_long: Start with a small rep count and add one or two reps each round across all cards.
science_rationale: Ladders create gradual overload and easy score tracking.
safety_notes: Keep early rounds easy enough to preserve quality.

name: Pyramid 10
instructions_short: Build reps up and back down across four cards.
instructions_long: Use 2-4-6-8 reps per card then descend as time allows. Keep movement quality consistent.
science_rationale: Progressive volume improves pacing awareness.
safety_notes: Avoid large jumps on high-load exercises.

name: Pyramid 15
instructions_short: Build and descend a longer five-card pyramid.
instructions_long: Use conservative increases and descend before form quality drops. Time-based cards use short holds.
science_rationale: Longer pyramids accumulate volume with a clear structure.
safety_notes: Scale early if fatigue changes mechanics.

name: Pyramid 5
instructions_short: Build reps up and then back down across three cards.
instructions_long: Perform 2-4-6 reps then descend if time allows. Use time-based holds as 15-20 second blocks.
science_rationale: Pyramids provide progressive exposure without needing max effort.
safety_notes: Stop at a manageable rung and keep transitions calm.

name: Tabata 10
instructions_short: Use 20 seconds work and 10 seconds rest across four cards.
instructions_long: Rotate through four cards for 20-on 10-off intervals until time expires.
science_rationale: Interval density supports conditioning when exercise selection is safe.
safety_notes: Choose low-skill movements and stop before form breaks.

name: Tabata 15
instructions_short: Rotate five cards with 20 seconds work and 10 seconds rest.
instructions_long: Keep intensity sustainable and repeat cards in order for the full 15-minute block.
science_rationale: Longer intervals require pacing to avoid excessive fatigue.
safety_notes: Use low-impact substitutions for beginners.

name: Tabata 5
instructions_short: Alternate two cards using 20 seconds work and 10 seconds rest.
instructions_long: Perform 20 seconds of work and 10 seconds of rest; alternating cards for approximately 5 minutes.
science_rationale: Short intervals can raise heart rate quickly with simple movements.
safety_notes: Avoid complex loaded exercises when moving fast.
